sources.quote: ICE has detained immigrants in Baltimore holding rooms for an average of 51 hours, four times longer than the maximum time limit under its longstanding policy
sources.searcher_note: Banner analysis of federal data on Baltimore hold rooms, Jan-mid 2025; also says about 93% of 2025 detentions exceeded 12 hours vs under 4% in 2024. Earlier window than the lead.

sources.quote: From Feb. 1 to mid-October of last year, almost all detainees — 95% — were held longer than 12 hours, typically the maximum, Rubin wrote. A nationwide waiver allowed detentions up to 72 hours, but 27% of detainees were still held beyond that.
sources.searcher_note: Federal judge's March 2026 ruling on Baltimore hold-room overcrowding; Feb-Oct 2025 window, 12h and 72h thresholds, not the lead's 24h or Oct 2025-Feb 2026.

sources.quote: During Donald Trump's first nine and a half months back in office, the number of detentions exceeding 72 hours increased from 281 to 5,011.
sources.searcher_note: National hold-room data (FOIA) through Oct 2025: 72-hour threshold, Biden 16 months vs Trump 9.5 months; also 140,000+ hold-room detentions Jan-Oct 2025. Different threshold and window from the lead.

sources.quote: ICE officials warned of dangerous crowding. See how they kept packing people in.
sources.searcher_note: Headline only (fetch returned 403). Post-cutoff national investigation of hold-room crowding; search snippet said ICE kept people in overcrowded holding rooms for days nationwide per agency data. Body not verified.

notes: Hold-room length-of-stay coverage is heavy, but every source found uses the 12h or 72h thresholds and windows ending by Oct 2025 (Banner: Baltimore Jan-Jul 2025; court: Feb-Oct 2025; Colorado Times Recorder: national through Oct 2025). None found states the lead's 24-hour cut, the 16,919 vs 212 count, or the Oct 2025-Feb 2026 Baltimore 3,041 of 3,168 / 87-hour median. CNN 2025-09-08 'Immigrants spend days in ICE hold rooms' (https://www.cnn.com/2025/09/08/us/detainees-ice-immigrants-hold-rooms) returned HTTP 451 and AZ Mirror 2026-09-02 Phoenix long-holds piece returned 403, so neither is recorded with a quote. Post-cutoff: Washington Post 2026-07-22 (paywalled, headline only).
